caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers standing on six turned baluster legs connected by wavy stretchers. The chest has five drawers: two small drawers at the top side by side and three larger drawers below in a vertical stack, with an additional narrow drawer in the lower section. Each drawer is fitted with metal pull handles and escutcheons, which appear golden or brass in color. The surface of the chest is decorated with intricate, colorful floral and bird motifs, predominantly in shades of red, green, orange, yellow, and light brown, set against a dark brown or black background. The sides of the chest also feature painted floral patterns. The chest stands on a pale, blank background, which accentuates its shape and details. The structure and decorative elements are rendered with attention to shading and light, giving the chest a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Highboy
